hf_dataset.note: Lab used HF Dianyo/poultry-fecal-fl (7016+1754) which appears to be augmented/upsampled from Zenodo 6812. Zenodo raw is 6812 (cocci 2103, healthy 2057, salmo 2276, ncd 376). HF adds ~1958 images (likely augmentation). Paper must cite HF as source and note discrepancy.

int8_finding: EB0 collapses 62.7% under INT8 dynamic PTQ (98.17->35.46%), while MN2 and SNV2 are robust (drop -0.22% and -0.05% - actually slight gain due to noise). EB0 uses SE blocks and compound scaling - highly sensitive to quantization. This is a major finding for paper.
